prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square transparent cutout illustration for the Sound design service of Abt Sonora, a colorful Brazilian music production website. Primary request: a striking editorial illustration about capturing and shaping everyday sounds, not about composing music. Subject: one beautifully stylized portable field recorder with two crossed microphone capsules on top, a matte ink-black body, peach face, a small blank dark display, orange recording button and sunflower-yellow controls. Arrange it diagonally as the main focal object. Around it, just two recognizable foley sound sources: a loosely curled metallic spring on the left and a crumpled folded peach paper sheet on the right. Three broad flowing orange, emerald and sky-blue paper ribbons emerge from behind the recorder and sweep around the objects, suggesting recorded sound being shaped into layers. Clear coherent composition rather than scattered icons. Style: handmade layered cut-paper collage, tactile visible paper fibers and subtle screenprint grain, slightly irregular bold contours, limited flat inks, subtle depth from physical paper overlaps. Sophisticated playful contemporary independent record sleeve art. Strict palette: ink #151718, peach #FFE5CF, sunflower #FFC629, orange #FF6B35, emerald #00B87C, sky #8ED8F8. Composition: mostly square, single cohesive still life fully contained, generous margins, strong silhouette readable at 400px, recorder clearly recognizable, objects visually separated. Output background genuinely transparent, no enclosing square or colored background, no ground plane or external drop shadow. No text, numbers, letters, brand logos, watermark, musical notes, headphones, keyboards, photorealism, glossy 3D, generic vector clipart or webpage mockups.
direction: Ilustração de papel recortado sobre captação e criação de efeitos, na paleta atual da Sonora.
